name: After § 44
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 2h. Expresses concern about the global prevalence of gender-based violence, including conflict-based violence, female genital mutilation, child and forced marriages, femicides (the killing of a woman or a girl on account of her gender), honour-based violence, ‘morality policing’, online hate speech, and the trafficking of women and girls; highlights the importance of recognising gender-based violence as an area of crime under Article 83(1) TFEU; welcomes the EU’s accession to the Istanbul Convention and urges the remaining EU Member States to ratify the Convention and implement its provisions;
